requirements: R1: Create an explicit mapping layer between internal task statuses and GitHub states
R2: Enforce that an internal state of 'done' is only valid if verified by external GitHub reality (PR merged)
R3: Implement an event-driven mechanism where task state changes publish a 'TaskCompletedEvent'
R4: Add validation to gracefully handle 404s/missing PRs when syncing task statuses with GitHub
R5: Separate the essential core Task definition from its contingent GitHub PR status by using a separate context object or status tracker
R6: Introduce explicit truth status tables or intermediate states (e.g., 'conflict_detected') for contradictions

slices.title: Separate Task core definition from contingent GitHub status tracker in database schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing the core Task schema for this epic, I want to extract contingent GitHub PR state and contradiction states into a separate tracker table, so that the core internal Task essence is not dependent on external service availability
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a core Task entity
When its GitHub PR status is synced
Then the contingent data is saved in a separate tracker table
And intermediate contradiction states (e.g., 'conflict_detected') can be accurately persisted
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' state occurrences from baseline to 0

slices.title: Implement explicit mapping layer and PR merge validation for Task states
slices.jtbd: When implementing status synchronization for this epic, I want to explicitly map internal states to GitHub realities and handle 404s, so that tasks are only marked 'done' when the PR is merged
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an unmerged or missing PR
When the sync process runs
Then the task is not marked as done and 404s are gracefully handled
And contradictions explicitly result in 'conflict_detected' state
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase sync success rate without silent failures to 99.9%

slices.title: Implement event-driven TaskCompletedEvent publishing
slices.jtbd: When implementing state changes for this epic, I want to publish a 'TaskCompletedEvent' as a speech act, so that intentionality is communicated to the rest of the system
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task whose status transitions to verified 'done'
When the state is persisted
Then an explicit 'TaskCompletedEvent' is published to the event bus
And downstream consumers are notified
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce missing state-change notifications from baseline to 0

slices.title: Verify GitHub status reconciliation and event publishing flows
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to test the full mapping, PR validation, and event publishing, so that no false success reports occur
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a mocked GitHub API returning 404 or unmerged PRs
When the sync process is triggered
Then the system records contradiction states and does not mark tasks as done
And unit, integration, and E2E tests confirm correct event publishing
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for PR sync edge cases to 100%

requirements: R1: Ensure clear traceability from UI components to their corresponding backend models and API endpoints in the UI
R2: Allow users to define or project their own custom views and categories for documents, replacing rigid hardcoded categories

slices.title: Design schema for user-defined document categories and views
slices.jtbd: When implementing data storage for this epic, I want to create tables for user-defined document categories and views, so that rigid hardcoded ontologies are removed
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user configuring their workspace
When they create a custom document category
Then the schema correctly persists their projection and associates it with the document set
And enforces uniqueness per user context
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce hardcoded category update requests by 100%

slices.title: Define shared API contract for custom categories and UI traceability
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API contract for this epic, I want to define the endpoints for fetching and managing custom categories and their underlying reference mappings, so that frontend and backend can build in parallel
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the need for dynamic categories
When the contract is defined
Then it includes endpoints for CRUD operations on user categories
And it includes explicit trace metadata for mapping UI components to backend endpoints
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 0 integration errors between parallel frontend and backend builds

slices.title: Implement API endpoints for dynamic user-defined categories
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backend for this epic, I want to build the API for custom document views and traceability references, so that the frontend can fetch personalized categorizations
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid user request for custom categories
When the API is called
Then it returns the dynamically configured views
And includes explicit traceability reference IDs mapped to the UI components
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve category API response times under 150ms at P95

slices.title: Implement dynamic user-defined views and explicit component traceability in FinancialModule
slices.jtbd: When implementing the UI for this epic, I want to render user-defined document categories and map them explicitly to backend references, so that users can control their own worldmaking ontology
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the FinancialModule UI
When a user interacts with the document list
Then the UI presents their custom-defined categories instead of hardcoded ones
And each UI component maintains explicit traceability to its backend data reference
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase user custom view adoption rate to > 60%

slices.title: Verify dynamic categories and traceability flow end-to-end
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to test the full flow of creating custom categories and verifying their UI traceability, so that the dynamic ontology works correctly across all layers
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a custom document category created via API
When the user navigates the FinancialModule UI
Then the dynamic category is correctly rendered and traceable back to the backend model
And E2E/integration tests confirm the explicit mapping
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for the dynamic category creation journey
